text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Haa, hah...

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"Did that... feel pretty good?
Felt like a really, really good vibe—"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: It was so good—♡

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
No way, for real? As expected, huh?
I am soooo totally a genius, aren't I? ♡
choice_data_list: Yeah, that was an amazing race!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Aha♡ Right~? Like, I've totally got talent, y'know?
And if I train properly, then all the more—

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: ...Mm, huh?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Then didn't you work hard too?
choice_data_list: Huh... W-What's with this all of a sudden!?
Huh... W-What's this all of a sudden!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: She had just been completely absorbed in praising herself, so her sudden sharp turn in attitude caught me completely off guard.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
This time, I properly listened to what you said
and worked super hard, right, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
And then, my body felt way lighter
than in my debut race, and I ran so fast♡

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
I worked hard, but~, you worked hard
too, right? Doing what you say really makes me
stronger~! I can totally feel it♡

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
So keep giving it your best from here on out♡
I'll even hang out with you a bit~!
choice_data_list: I see...! That's great to hear!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I, too, have grown quite accustomed to working hand-in-hand with her.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Once the new year begins, the Classic Year finally arrives.
Ahead lies the first leg of the Tiara route, the Oka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
The Oka Sho, huh...
It's finally here!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Plus, I'm a total genius, right?
And on top of that, I've got your training, yeah?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Triple Tiara's gonna be a breeze☆

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"It's not that simple" almost escaped my lips,
but I swallowed the words back down.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: She's changing, too. She's definitely not just a soft marshmallow heart anymore.
choice_data_list: Yeah, looking good! That's the spirit!
Yeah, sounds great! That's the spirit!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Hehe♡
Right, right~?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so began the days of running full speed toward the first race of the Triple Tiara, the Oka Sho!
